breakfast.name: Sausage spinach egg muffins
ingredients: 8 oz cooked turkey breakfast sausage, crumbled
steps: On Sunday, heat the oven to 350 F and spray a 12-cup muffin tin well.
Divide the crumbled sausage, spinach, and bell pepper among the cups.
Whisk the eggs, cottage cheese, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, then pour into the cups about three-quarters full.
Top with the cheddar and bake 20 to 22 minutes until set in the center.
Cool, then refrigerate in a sealed container.
To serve, microwave 2 muffins per person for 45 to 60 seconds and eat with apple slices.

lunch.name: Blueberry-peach smoothie
ingredients: Optional: 1/2 frozen banana, a squeeze of lemon, or a few ice cubes
steps: Add almond milk and yogurt to the blender first.
Add protein powder, spinach, blueberries, peaches, almond butter, and flaxseed.
Blend on high 45 to 60 seconds until smooth, adding a splash of water if too thick.
Pour into two glasses and drink right away.

dinner.name: Honey-mustard chicken sheet pan
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a large sheet pan.
Toss broccoli and carrots with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper and spread on the pan.
Whisk Dijon, honey, vinegar, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and the remaining oil, and coat the chicken.
Nestle the chicken among the vegetables and roast 22 to 25 minutes until the chicken reaches 165 F.
Rest 3 minutes, then serve.

breakfast.name: Blueberry almond oats
steps: The night before, whisk almond milk, Greek yogurt, and protein powder until smooth.
Stir in the oats, chia seeds, almond butter, and blueberries, divide between two jars, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, stir, add a splash of milk if thick, and top with the sliced almonds.

dinner.name: Garlic shrimp + cauli rice
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined (thawed if frozen)
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat, add garlic and pepper flakes for 30 seconds, then add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink; move to a plate.
Add the cauliflower rice and snap peas to the skillet with a pinch of salt and cook 4 to 5 minutes until the rice is hot and peas are bright green.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, return the shrimp, squeeze in the lemon, and top with Parmesan.

dinner.name: Turkey white bean chili
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the turkey, onion, and peppers 6 to 7 minutes, breaking up the meat, until no longer pink.
Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, and oregano and cook 30 seconds.
Add broth, beans, and green chiles, bring to a boil, then simmer 12 minutes until slightly thickened.
Season with lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Serve half topped with avocado and cheddar, and refrigerate the other half for Saturday lunch.

dinner.name: Lemon tilapia + green beans
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a sheet pan.
Toss green beans and tomatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, half the garlic, salt, and pepper and spread on the pan; roast 8 minutes.
Pat the fish dry, rub with the remaining oil, garlic, oregano, salt, pepper, and lemon zest, then nestle on the pan.
Roast 10 to 12 minutes until the fish flakes easily.
Squeeze lemon over everything and serve.

dinner.name: Chicken sausage + peppers
ingredients: 12 oz fully cooked chicken sausage links, sliced
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the sausage slices 3 to 4 minutes; move to a plate.
Add the peppers and onion with a pinch of salt and cook 6 to 7 minutes until softened and lightly charred.
Add garlic, smoked paprika, and Italian seasoning for 30 seconds, then add the kale and broth.
Cover 2 minutes until the kale wilts, return the sausage, toss, and serve.

breakfast.name: Veggie scramble + avocado
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and cook the onion 2 minutes until soft.
Add spinach and tomatoes, cook 1 minute, then pour in the eggs and scramble gently until just set.
Divide between two plates, top with avocado, and serve with the berries.

lunch.name: Leftover turkey chili
steps: Reheat the chili in a pot over medium heat for 5 to 8 minutes, stirring, until steaming.
Divide between two bowls and top with avocado, cheddar, a spoon of Greek yogurt, and a squeeze of lime.

dinner.name: Chili-lime salmon + Brussels
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a sheet pan.
Toss Brussels sprouts with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper and roast 12 minutes.
Mix chili powder, cumin, lime zest, garlic, the remaining oil, salt, and pepper and rub over the salmon.
Push the sprouts aside, add the salmon skin side down, and roast 10 to 12 minutes until the salmon flakes.
Squeeze lime juice over everything and serve.

breakfast.name: Cottage peach bowls + eggs
ingredients: 2 ripe peaches, sliced (or 1 cup thawed frozen peach slices)
steps: Cover the eggs with cold water in a pot, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat, cover, and let sit 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, divide the cottage cheese between two bowls, top with peaches and almonds, and dust with cinnamon (drizzle honey if you like).
Move the eggs to ice water for 2 minutes, peel, and serve 2 per person with the bowls.

lunch.name: Chickpea cucumber salad
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion and toss gently.
Top with feta and serve over spinach if you like.

dinner.name: Herb pork + sweet potato
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut in 3/4-inch cubes
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a large sheet pan.
Toss sweet potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper and roast 10 minutes.
Rub the pork with Dijon, thyme, rosemary, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the pork and green beans (tossed with the remaining oil) to the pan and roast 18 to 22 minutes until the pork reaches 145 F.
Rest the pork 5 minutes, slice, and serve with the vegetables.
